results.name: Finset.card_eq_one
results.source_text:
theorem card_eq_one : #s = 1 ↔ ∃ a, s = {a} := by
  cases s
  simp only [Multiset.card_eq_one, Finset.card, ← val_inj, singleton_val]

results.name: Finset.card
results.source_text:
/-- `s.card` is the number of elements of `s`, aka its cardinality.

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale. -/
def card (s : Finset α) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.card s.1
results.docstring:
`s.card` is the number of elements of `s`, aka its cardinality.

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale.

results.name: Finset.card_one
results.source_text:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem card_one : #(1 : Finset α) = 1 :=
  card_singleton _

results.name: Finset.equivOfCardEq
results.source_text:
/-- Noncomputable equivalence between two finsets `s` and `t` as fintypes when there is a proof
that `#s = #t`. -/
noncomputable def Finset.equivOfCardEq {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} (h : #s = #t) :
    s ≃ t := Fintype.equivOfCardEq ((Fintype.card_coe _).trans (h.trans (Fintype.card_coe _).symm))
results.docstring:
Noncomputable equivalence between two finsets `s` and `t` as fintypes when there is a proof
that `#s = #t`.

results.name: ZMod.pow_div_two_eq_neg_one_or_one
results.source_text:
/-- If `a : ZMod p` is nonzero, then `a^(p/2)` is either `1` or `-1`. -/
theorem pow_div_two_eq_neg_one_or_one {a : ZMod p} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    a ^ (p / 2) = 1 ∨ a ^ (p / 2) = -1 := by
  rcases Prime.eq_two_or_odd (@Fact.out p.Prime _) with rfl | hp_odd
  · revert a ha; intro a; fin_cases a
    · tauto
    · simp
  rw [← mul_self_eq_one_iff, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, two_mul_odd_div_two hp_odd]
  exact pow_card_sub_one_eq_one ha
results.docstring: If `a : ZMod p` is nonzero, then `a^(p/2)` is either `1` or `-1`.

results.name: LorentzGroup.det_eq_one_or_neg_one
results.source_text:
/-- The determinant of a member of the Lorentz group is `1` or `-1`. -/
lemma det_eq_one_or_neg_one (Λ : 𝓛 d) : Λ.1.det = 1 ∨ Λ.1.det = -1 := by
  refine mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp ?_
  simpa only [det_mul, det_dual, det_one] using congrArg det ((mem_iff_self_mul_dual).mp Λ.2)
results.docstring: The determinant of a member of the Lorentz group is `1` or `-1`.
